Manage your HappyView plugins in the registry

Usage: hpy registry plugin [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init       Write hpy.toml's [project] and create the plugin's project in the registry
  show       Show the plugin's project as the registry has it
  edit       Edit the plugin's project in the registry
  pull       Copy the plugin's project from the registry into hpy.toml's [project]
  publish    Publish the plugin in the current directory as a new version
  status     Show what the registry knows about this plugin's versions
  lifecycle  Record a lifecycle event (end of support, end of life, …) for a version or the whole
             project
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json      Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --no-input  Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need --yes.
                  Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>        Run as if started in DIR
  -h, --help      Print help
